Lenovo Legion 5 16IRX10 Gaming Laptop

Experience apex tier portable gaming performance with the Lenovo Legion 5 16IRX10 (83LY00HTLK) workstation laptop, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Driven by the flagship Intel Core i9-14900HX hybrid architecture processor and packed with the next-generation NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 8GB dedicated graphics framework, this machine destroys rendering queues and AAA game boundaries seamlessly. Equipped with 32GB of high-frequency DDR5 memory array and a lightning-fast 1TB NVMe PCIe Gen4 SSD buffer, multi-tasking and level loads happen instantly. Enjoy unparalleled visual depth on the brilliant 15.1-inch WQXGA OLED display layout running at a fluid 165Hz refresh frequency rate with deep contrast profiles. Optimized effectively by the Legion Coldfront thermal matrix, built with a premium gaming chassis, and pre-installed with Windows 11, this top-tier gaming rig comes backed by a 1-year warranty setup.
